name: One-arm pull-up
description: A full pull-up on one arm from a dead hang. It needs a large base of two-arm strength, then uneven and one-arm loading.

steps.label: Pull-up
steps.cue: Strict reps from a full hang, no kipping.

steps.label: One-arm hang
steps.cue: Per arm; keep the shoulder active and the body from spinning.

steps.label: Archer pull-up
steps.cue: Reps per side; keep the guiding arm as straight as you can.

steps.label: One-arm pull-up negative
steps.cue: Reps per arm; lower for five to eight seconds.

steps.label: Towel assisted one-arm pull-up
steps.cue: Reps per arm; grip the towel lower as you get stronger.

steps.label: One-arm pull-up
steps.cue: Reps per arm; brace hard so you do not spin.
